verdict.rationale: Bolt integrates with GitHub for automatic commit history, branches, and full change history (bolt-docs-31, bolt-docs-2, bolt-docs-30), giving version control, and Code view lets you inspect/edit the underlying code for review (bolt-docs-1, bolt-docs-17). Rollback is only hinted at via a community tip to 'revert and try with an updated prompt' (bolt-comm-10) rather than a documented first‑class rollback feature. Missing for 10: explicit first-party docs on an in-app revert/checkpoint mechanism, and a formal review workflow (e.g., PR/diff review) beyond raw GitHub branch usage.
